title: The Inviting the New Neighbor In
youtube_title: The Inviting the New Neighbor In | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A shy try, done kindly, is already courage.
summary: At a lantern walk along the evening lane, Anil feels shy about an invitation that only needed one sentence. Instead of pretending not to care, Anil tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Nana Ruth stays kind and does not push for a show.
